name: Codex · Orchestrator
notes: Use codex-orchestrate to plan approved work, delegate through Paseo, coordinate review and integration.

name: Codex · Implementer · heavy
notes: High-complexity ticket: architecture, migrations, public APIs, cross-module refactoring. No further delegation.

name: Codex · Implementer · medium
notes: Typical feature, bug fix, UI code or scoped fixes after review. No further delegation.

name: Codex · Implementer · light
notes: Local change in a few files with no public API change. No further delegation.

name: Codex · Implementer · trivial
notes: Mechanical renames, boilerplate or small documentation updates. No further delegation.

name: Codex · Merger
notes: Sequential ticket merge in the integration workspace. Escalate semantic conflicts; never discard changes.

name: Codex · Reviewer
notes: Standards or Spec review. Read-only brief: report evidence and do not edit files. Role instructions do not enforce an OS sandbox.

name: Codex · Research · code
notes: Investigate this codebase. Read-only brief; use CodeGraph when indexed, otherwise rg/read. Return evidence.

name: Codex · Research · web
notes: Research documentation or APIs with actual web tools and citations. Do not edit repository code. Report unavailable web tools.

name: Codex · Images
notes: Generate requested image assets only if an image generation tool is available. A Codex model alone does not provide one.

name: Codex · Advisor
notes: Independent architecture opinion, read-only. Uses the same model family by default; do not call this cross-family review.

name: Codex · Arbiter
notes: Resolve disputed review findings using requirements and evidence. Read-only; escalate unresolved product decisions.
